title: Security Headers: Content Security Policy and More | Orchard Core
description:
Every response your site sends to a browser carries headers. Some of them are security instructions: what a page may load, which browser features it may use, and what a link reveals about the page.

The Orchard Core Security module sets these headers from the admin, under Settings, Security, Security Headers. This video shows the Content Security Policy, Permissions Policy and Referrer Policy tabs, and what the site sends when you change nothing.

In this video:
• How security headers work, and the four headers of the Security module
• Opening the Security Headers settings
• Content Security Policy: sources, Frame Ancestors and Object Source
• Permissions Policy: None, Any and Self
• Referrer Policy: choosing how much a link reveals
• Good to know: the permissions and the settings made by a developer
